questions.question: Where is the APEC summit being held this year?
questions.explanation: The APEC summit is taking place in the city of Shenzhen, China.

questions.question: Which country launched drone attacks against a US military base in Bahrain?
questions.explanation: Iran conducted the drone attacks against the US military base in Bahrain.

questions.question: What structure did Ukraine damage to disrupt Russian supply lines?
questions.explanation: Ukraine severely damaged the Kerch Bridge, which links Russia to the Crimean peninsula.

questions.question: What is the status of former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang?
options: He is returning to his job next week.
He is retiring to travel the world.
The company board rejected his return.
He is buying a new technology company.
questions.explanation: The board of directors stated they have no plans to hire Jensen Huang back after his resignation.

questions.question: What essential items are currently stuck at the border waiting to enter Gaza?
questions.explanation: International groups report that vital supplies like food, medicine, and 150,000 tents are stuck at the border.
